استرضيت (form X)
# اِسْتَرْضَيْتُ (istarḍaytu) /is.tar.dˤaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
# اِسْتَرْضَيْتَ (istarḍayta) /is.tar.dˤaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
# اِسْتَرْضَيْتِ (istarḍayti) /is.tar.dˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
# اُسْتُرْضِيتُ (usturḍītu) /us.tur.dˤiː.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
